name: Lamp walk
summary: Walking someone home over chat at night: a drawn street from where she left to her place with a row of lamp posts; each lamp lights as she passes it so the friend sees how far she is without a map, 'I'm home' lights her window, and if a stretch takes much longer than usual it quietly offers him a 'You ok?' and her an 'I'm ok'.
useWhen: leaving the library rn its so dark
stay on with me till i get home?
text me when you're home safe
omw back from the party, 15 min walk
dontUseWhen: live location sharing or a map with a route
a group getting home from a night out (several walkers)
a ride being driven (use pickup-run or carpool)

walker.description: Who's walking (a name in the chat)

watcher.description: Who's keeping her company (a name in the chat)

quote.description: What the walker said, in her words

reply.description: What the watcher said back, in his words; may be empty

time.description: When it started, as said, e.g. '1:05am'; may be empty

lamps.description: Lamp posts on the way, 4 to 14

usualMin.description: How many minutes the walk usually takes
